name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_profile_combo_sel_change
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::OnProfileComboSelChange stores the selected profile-combo index and refreshes the connect-string edit from that profile.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
USER32 SendMessageA and MFC CWnd::SetWindowTextA are verified as provider boundaries by smoke-test patches rather than by live combo-box UI execution.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x442080 validates a thiscall void handler that sends CB_GETCURSEL to m_profileCombo.m_hWnd, stores the returned index at m_selectedProfileIndex, and calls CWnd::SetWindowTextA on m_connectStringEdit with m_profileConnectStrings[index].

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_profile_combo_sel_change_smoke patches USER32 SendMessageA and CWnd::SetWindowTextA, returns selected index 1, and verifies the message contract, stored index, edit control receiver, and selected connect-string text.
